content.label:
This is truly one of the greatest apps ever invented. I'm currently recovering from shoulder surgery and unable to type, but my job requires a great deal of written communication. Flow has allowed me to not miss a beat.

Without it, my choices would be to endure pain and lengthen my recovery by forcing myself to type before my shoulder is ready, or fall way behind in work and lose revenue. None of that is necessary because Flow allows me to quickly and easily communicate with clear elocution and professionalism, even without a keyboard.

Honestly, I don't think I will even go back to typing when my shoulder heals. Everything is so much faster with Flow and so much easier. It's very intuitive software which rarely makes mistakes. I truly cannot recommend it highly enough.
